name: Sorcerer
summary: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline. Sorcerers know fewer spells than wizards but bend them with Metamagic: twin them, quicken them, or cast them silently.

hitPoints.Hit Points at Higher Levels: 1d6 (or 4) + your Constitution modifier per sorcerer level after 1st

proficiencies.Weapons: Daggers, darts, slings, quarterstaffs, light crossbows
proficiencies.Skills: Choose two from Arcana, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion and Religion

spellcastingNotes: You know a fixed number of sorcerer spells, shown in the Spells Known column.

classFeatures.name: Spellcasting
keyFacts: You know a fixed number of sorcerer spells (see Spells Known); when you level up you can swap one.
Spell save DC = 8 + PB + CHA; spell attack = PB + CHA.
classFeatures.summary: You can cast sorcerer spells. You know a fixed number of sorcerer spells (see Spells Known); when you level up you can swap one. CHA is your spellcasting ability: spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + CHA modifier, spell attack = proficiency bonus + CHA modifier. You can use an arcane focus as a spellcasting focus. You regain all spell slots on a long rest.

classFeatures.name: Sorcerous Origin
classFeatures.summary: Choose the source of your innate magic. It grants features at 1st, 6th, 14th and 18th level.
classFeatures.short: Choose where your magic comes from.

classFeatures.name: Font of Magic
keyFacts: Points = sorcerer level, refill on a long rest.
Bonus action to convert slots and points.
classFeatures.summary: You have sorcery points equal to your sorcerer level, restored on a long rest. As a bonus action you can turn spell slots into sorcery points (points equal to the slot level) or sorcery points into slots: 2 points for 1st, 3 for 2nd, 5 for 3rd, 6 for 4th, 7 for 5th level.
classFeatures.short: Sorcery points: turn them into slots and back.

classFeatures.name: Metamagic
classFeatures.summary: You can twist your spells to suit your needs. You learn two Metamagic options, one more at 10th and another at 17th level. Only one Metamagic option can be used per spell unless noted.
classFeatures.short: Spend sorcery points to bend your spells.

options.name: Careful Spell
options.summary: 1 point: chosen creatures automatically succeed on the spell's saving throw.

options.name: Distant Spell
options.summary: 1 point: double the spell's range, or make a touch spell reach 30 feet.

options.name: Empowered Spell
options.summary: 1 point: reroll up to CHA modifier damage dice.

options.name: Extended Spell
options.summary: 1 point: double a spell's duration (up to 24 hours).

options.name: Heightened Spell
options.summary: 3 points: one target has disadvantage on its first save against the spell.

options.name: Quickened Spell
options.summary: 2 points: cast a 1-action spell as a bonus action.

options.name: Subtle Spell
options.summary: 1 point: cast without verbal or somatic components.

options.name: Twinned Spell
options.summary: Points = spell level (1 for cantrips): target a second creature with a single-target spell.

options.name: Seeking Spell
options.summary: 2 points: reroll a missed spell attack.

options.name: Transmuted Spell
options.summary: 1 point: change the damage type to acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder.

classFeatures.name: Ability Score Improvement
keyFacts: +2 to one ability or +1 to two, or a feat.
classFeatures.summary: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, 19th level, you can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. You can't raise a score above 20 this way. If your DM allows feats, you can take a feat instead.
classFeatures.short: Raise one ability by 2, two by 1, or take a feat.

classFeatures.name: Sorcerous Restoration
keyFacts: +4 sorcery points on each short rest.
classFeatures.summary: You regain 4 expended sorcery points whenever you finish a short rest.
classFeatures.short: Regain 4 sorcery points on a short rest.

journeyStages.label: Class
journeyStages.summary: Review the sorcerer at a glance.

journeyStages.label: Class Features
journeyStages.summary: What your class gives you, level by level.

highlights.title: Combat Role
highlights.body: Flexible blaster: a short list of strong spells that Metamagic makes faster, farther-reaching or doubled.

highlights.title: Core Resources
highlights.body: Sorcery points (equal to your level) fuel Metamagic or turn into extra spell slots. You know a fixed list of spells.

highlights.title: Level Rhythm
highlights.body: Origin at 1, Font of Magic at 2, Metamagic at 3, 3rd-level spells at 5, more Metamagic at 10 and 17.
